detailed_descriptions.en: Build powerful party synergies and fight through unforgiving battles as you explore and save a realm torn apart by divine war. When one run ends in death, resurrection begins the next. Embrace scaling difficulties that add new layers of challenges, from random modifiers added to enemies to map-wide trials that affect the entire encounter. Each run and encounter will be fresh as you try out different party builds. Victory depends on how you combine your heroes: chain their powers and create devastating synergies. With 150+ Items to build around and 200+ Abilities , each with its own upgrade path, the build options are limitless. Theorycraft your way to broken, game-breaking combos. Lead your champions alone or rally up to three friends in fast-paced co-op play. With simultaneous turns for all players, battles remain fast and tactical, as you fight for the realm’s survival together. Earn Ultimate Charge from every move, whether attacking, casting spells, or defending. Each hero wields a unique Ultimate Ability to turn the tide—breaking enemy ranks, empowering allies, or unleashing overwhelming force. Upgrades don’t just raise stats; they evolve abilities, unlock new mechanics, and deepen hero playstyles. Assemble your party from 6 unique heroes, each with their own 3 distinct subclasses to that alter their playstyle.
